title: Telling the time to five minutes
examples: How do I tell the time to 5 minutes?
How do I read the minutes on a clock?

explain.say: Your bus leaves at 25 past 7. Will you catch it? Look at the clock: the long hand points to 5, and the short hand is between 7 and 8. Let us learn to read it together.

draw.text: Telling the time to five minutes

explain.say: Now look! Here it is in 3D: an analogue clock. Can you see the hour hand and the minute hand? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.

draw.text: Telling the time to five minutes

explain.say: For the long hand, each number on the clock means 5 minutes. Here it points to 1, so it is 5 minutes past 7. Counting in fives is the trick! What would the 2 mean?
The long hand on 2 means 10 minutes past 7. Count in fives as it moves round: 1 is 5, 2 is 10, 3 is 15, 4 is 20. What will the long hand on 5 mean?
5 fives are 25, so the long hand on 5 means 25 past 7. Past means after the hour. The short hand has gone almost halfway to 8. Can you see it?

Super job! After half past, we can count what is left: the long hand on 10 shows 50 minutes past 7, which is also 10 to 8. Wow: the tiny marks between numbers show single minutes. Challenge: what time is it when the long hand is on 8?

faq.q: How do I tell the time to 5 minutes?
faq.a: Read the hour from the short hand. Then count in fives round the clock to the number the long hand points to: 1 is 5, 2 is 10, 3 is 15, and so on.
asks: How do I read the minutes on a clock?

faq.a: It means 25 minutes after 7 o'clock, written 7:25. The long hand points to 5, and the short hand is between 7 and 8.
It means 10 minutes before 8 o'clock, which is 7:50. The long hand points to 10.

faq.q: Why does each number mean 5 minutes?
faq.a: There are 60 minutes in an hour and 12 numbers on the clock. 60 shared by 12 is 5, so the long hand takes 5 minutes to go from one number to the next.
asks: Why do we count in fives on a clock?

faq.q: When do I say past and when do I say to?
faq.a: Up to half past, say minutes past the hour. After half past, many people say minutes to the next hour, like 20 to 8 for 7:40.

facts: The minute hand takes 5 minutes to move from one number to the next.
7:50 can be said as 50 past 7 or 10 to 8.

quiz.say: The long hand points to 4 and the short hand is just past 2. What time is it?
quiz.show: The long hand points to 4 and the short hand is just past 2. What time is it?
quiz.why: The long hand on 4 means 4 fives, which is 20 minutes, past 2.

wrong.1: Each number is worth 5 minutes, not 1.
wrong.2: The short hand shows the hour, which is 2, not 4.

quiz.say: Where does the long hand point at 35 past 6?
quiz.show: Where does the long hand point at 35 past 6?
quiz.why: 35 is 7 fives, so the long hand points to 7.

wrong.0: 6 is near the short hand, which shows the hour.
wrong.2: The long hand on 3 would mean 15 minutes past.
